item.title: Bucks County man convicted of first-degree murder in 'rage-fueled' stabbing of ex-girlfriend
item.description: A Bucks County jury found Trevor Weigel guilty of first-degree murder for the February 2024 stabbing death of his 19-year-old ex-girlfriend, Jaden Battista, in Lower Makefield Township.

item.title: Chester County man admits to abusing, killing 12-year-old daughter; sentenced to life: DA
item.description: Rendell Hoagland, 54, pleaded guilty to abusing and killing his 12-year-old daughter, Malinda, and has been sentenced to life in prison without parole plus 30 to 60 years.

item.title: Phillies offseason draws mixed reaction as Mets, Dodgers make big signings
item.description: Phillies fans are voicing concerns as rival teams strengthen their rosters, while the Eagles’ early playoff exit has shifted attention to baseball and basketball in the city.

item.title: Snow in Philly this weekend: Here's how much to expect
item.description: FOX 29 Meteorologist Drew Anderson says snow is on the way for the region, with the heaviest amounts expected north and west of Philadelphia and a sharp drop in temperatures to follow.

item.title: Missing Philadelphia teen located after reported luring to San Diego through Roblox
item.description: Jahmez Cartwright, 18, from Southwest Philadelphia who was reported missing earlier this week has been found, according to his family and the Black and Missing Foundation.

item.title: Overnight fire evacuates multiple floors of 22-unit Conshohocken Avenue high-rise
item.description: An overnight fire at the River Park Condominiums on Conshohocken Avenue prompted evacuations on multiple floors. One person was taken to a nearby hospital for smoke inhalation.

item.title: Man shot in ankle on West Hilton Street in North Philadelphia
item.description: Philadelphia police are investigating a daytime shooting in North Philly that sent one man to the hospital.

item.title: More snow expected Sunday in Philadelphia, New Jersey: Here’s how much could fall
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued new winter weather advisories for Sunday across the Philadelphia area and parts of New Jersey, with 1 to 4 inches of snow possible.

item.title: More snow expected in Philadelphia area until Sunday night: How many inches will fall?
item.description: Keep those shovels handy, because the Philadelphia area is bracing for its second round of snow this weekend.

item.title: Husband, wife killed after vehicle crashes into NJ home, catches on fire
item.description: A tragic crash claimed the lives of a husband and wife, and left part of a home destroyed in South Jersey this weekend.
